verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background autonomous runs are a fair axis for infrastructure-as-code tooling, but the evidence shows no OpenTofu feature that sets up such automations. The CLI commands (plan with -out, test, import), the OCI container image and the 'automate your development workflow' marketing are building blocks or adjacent features that a user would have to wire into external CI or schedulers. They are not the product's own background automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
